Yes, in the v2 snapshot `Path` exposes `move_into`, and it was added in Python 3.14.

`library/pathlib.rst` documents `Path.move_into(target_dir)`. It moves a file or directory tree into an existing directory and returns the new `Path`. The entry carries `.. versionadded:: 3.14`.
